name: Ticket Manager – Sell Tickets for Events, Concerts, Conferences, and More with WooCommerce
author: PluginEver

sections.description:
Ticket Manager is a WooCommerce extension that allows you to sell tickets for events, concerts, conferences, workshops, fundraisers, or private functions directly from your WooCommerce store. It integrates with WooCommerce to create and manage tickets, automate email confirmations, track attendees, and generate reports without relying on third-party ticketing services.

This plugin helps store owners transform their WooCommerce site into a complete ticketing platform with event-specific customization and attendee management.

Key Use Cases

  • Event organizers and venue owners
  • Promoters and marketing teams
  • Educational institutions
  • Non-profit organizations
  • Businesses hosting conferences or workshops
  • Artists, performers, or creative events
  • And anyone looking to sell tickets for their events

With Ticket Manager, You Can Sell

  • Concerts and Festivals: Manage ticket sales for live music and public events.
  • Conferences and Seminars: Handle registrations for business or educational events.
  • Workshops and Classes: Sell tickets for training or skill-based sessions.
  • Sports and Fitness Events: Manage entries for matches, tournaments, or fitness programs.
  • Exhibitions and Art Shows: Organize ticketing for art, cultural, or trade events.
  • Online Webinars and Virtual Events: Support registrations for digital or live-streamed events.
  • Charity and Fundraising Events: Manage tickets for community or nonprofit programs.
  • Corporate and Private Events: Handle access for business meetings or private gatherings.
  • Fairs and Festivals: Manage ticketing for local, seasonal, or cultural fairs.
  • **And many more.

Live Demo | Documentation | Upgrade to Pro

Key Features

  • Ticket Creation: Create and sell tickets for any type of event directly from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Customizable Ticket Templates: Define ticket prefixes, suffixes, and lengths to match event requirements.
  • Automated Email Confirmations: Automatically send tickets and order confirmations to customers.
  • Custom Fields: Add extra fields to collect attendee details (e.g., special requests or requirements).
  • Attendee Management: Manage attendee lists, mark check-ins, and export attendee data.
  • Discounts and Coupons: Integrate WooCommerce coupons for event-specific discounts.
  • Payment Gateway Support: Compatible with all WooCommerce-supported payment gateways.
  • Mobile Responsive: Fully optimized for ticket display and scanning on mobile devices.
  • Reporting: Track sales, ticket counts, and attendee data in real time.
  • Regular Updates and Support: Ongoing updates for compatibility and performance improvements.

⚡ Upcoming Features

We continuously enhance our plugin to improve functionality and user experience. The following features are currently in development and will be released in future updates:

  • QR Code Generation: Add unique QR codes to tickets for faster check-in and improved event security.
  • Ticket Scanning App: Use a dedicated mobile app to scan and validate tickets at the venue for quick and seamless entry.
  • Ticket Templates: Design personalized ticket templates with your branding, logo, and color scheme to match your event style.
  • Event-Specific Customization: Configure event details such as date, time, layout, ticket prefixes or suffixes, and numbering options for precise event management.
  • Analytics and Reporting: Access insights on sales trends, attendee demographics, and other key data to guide future planning and marketing.
  • Real-Time Sales Tracking: Monitor ticket sales as they happen to manage event capacity and performance effectively.
  • Social Media Integration: Promote events and ticket sales directly on social media platforms to reach a wider audience.
  • Enhanced Validation and Security: Strengthen security with advanced validation to prevent ticket duplication and unauthorized access.
  • Content Restriction for Ticket Holders: Limit access to specific pages or posts for verified ticket buyers, enabling exclusive event content.

  • Serial Numbers
  • Min Max Quantities
  • Donation Manager
  • Product Category Slider
  • Product Category Showcase
  • Product Variation Swatches

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.2 or greater
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or greater
  • PHP 7.4 or greater (PHP 8.0 or higher recommended)
  • MySQL 5.6 or greater, or MariaDB 10.1 or greater

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin area.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for Ticket Manager by PluginEver.
  4. Click Install Now, and then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/wc-ticket-manager/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.

Updating

Automatic updates are supported. It is recommended to back up your site before updating.
sections.faq:
How can I create a ticket?

Edit or add a new WooCommerce product and enable the “Sell Tickets” option. Configure the price and ticket details by navigating to Ticket Options. Once saved, the ticket product will be ready for sale.

Can I customize the ticket template?

Yes. You can adjust ticket prefixes, suffixes, and numbering in the Ticket Options tab from the Product Data section. The email template can also be customized under Ticket Manager > Settings > Emails.

How do I manage attendees?

From the Ticket Manager section, view and manage attendee lists, mark check-ins, and export attendee data in CSV format.

Can I use coupons for tickets?

Yes. Use WooCommerce’s Marketing > Coupons section to create and apply discount codes for specific events or ticket products.

How to export ticket data?

You can export ticket data by going to the “Ticket Manager” menu in your WordPress dashboard, selecting the “Tools” sub-menu, and then clicking the “Export” tab. From there, choose the data you want to export, such as sales records, attendee lists, or other metrics, and download it in CSV format for analysis or external use.

How do I get support?

You can get support for the plugin by visiting the PluginEver Support page. Here you can submit a support ticket, ask questions, and get help with any issues you may have while using the plugin.
